violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. -Chicken thighs and pork ribs on the same tray in the bottom of the refrigerator in the kitchen.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floor of the walk in freezer needs cleaned.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not maintained in good repair. -Cracked floor tiles by the ice machine. Ceiling seam needs repair in the kitchen.
